title: Kanban filters and search

discoveries.title: URL Search Params for Filter Persistence
discoveries.description: TanStack Router validateSearch with Zod provides type-safe, URL-persisted filter state without needing Zustand or useState. Filters persist on refresh and are shareable via URL.
discoveries.implementation: validateSearch: (search) => SearchSchema.parse(search) in route config, then Route.useSearch() in component
discoveries.applicability: All list views with filters (F031 features list, F032 sessions list)

discoveries.title: Constants Reuse via Component Export
discoveries.description: Instead of duplicating CATEGORIES and PHASES from feature-form.tsx, exported them for reuse in kanban-filter-bar.tsx. Maintains single source of truth and prevents enum divergence.
discoveries.implementation: export const CATEGORIES/PHASES in feature-form.tsx, import in kanban-filter-bar.tsx
discoveries.applicability: Any component needing shared enum definitions

discoveries.title: Client-Side Filtering Simplicity
discoveries.description: Applied simple JavaScript array.filter() at page level before passing to KanbanBoard. No API changes needed, instant UI feedback.
discoveries.implementation: Filter logic in kanban.tsx: search (substring, case-insensitive), category (exact match), phase (exact match)
discoveries.applicability: When dataset fits in memory; use server-side filtering for large datasets (>1000 items)

what_worked: Exported constants from existing component (PAT-013) - avoided duplication
URL search params via validateSearch - clean, type-safe, shareable
Client-side filtering before component render - no API overhead
Used existing Select component from shadcn/ui - pattern consistency
Single iteration pass - proper planning led to zero retries
Fixed accessibility issue quickly - aria-label added to search input
